const arabic=n=>String(n).replace(/\d/g,d=>'٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'[Number(d)]);
let index=0,submitted=false;
const answers={};
const byId=id=>document.getElementById(id);
function render(){const q=QUESTIONS[index];byId('counter').textContent=`السؤال ${arabic(index+1)} من ${arabic(QUESTIONS.length)}`;byId('quiz').innerHTML=`<div class="q-number">السؤال ${arabic(index+1)}</div><h3 class="question-title"></h3><div id="choices"></div>`;document.querySelector('.question-title').textContent=q.q;const wrap=byId('choices');q.options.forEach(o=>{const label=document.createElement('label');label.className='choice';if(answers[q.id]===o.letter)label.classList.add('selected');if(submitted&&o.letter===q.answer)label.classList.add('correct');if(submitted&&answers[q.id]===o.letter&&o.letter!==q.answer)label.classList.add('wrong');const input=document.createElement('input');input.type='radio';input.name='choice';input.checked=answers[q.id]===o.letter;input.disabled=submitted;input.addEventListener('change',()=>{answers[q.id]=o.letter;render()});const letter=document.createElement('b');letter.textContent=o.letter;const span=document.createElement('span');span.textContent=o.text;label.append(input,letter,span);wrap.append(label)});const answered=Object.keys(answers).length;byId('answered').textContent=arabic(answered);byId('remaining').textContent=arabic(QUESTIONS.length-answered);byId('bar').style.width=`${answered/QUESTIONS.length*100}%`;byId('prev').disabled=index===0;byId('next').disabled=index===QUESTIONS.length-1;byId('steps').textContent=`${arabic(index+1)} / ${arabic(QUESTIONS.length)}`;byId('state').textContent=submitted?'مكتمل':'جارٍ الحل';if(submitted){byId('submit').hidden=true;byId('hint').textContent='راجع الإجابات الصحيحة والخاطئة'} }
byId('prev').onclick=()=>{index--;render()};byId('next').onclick=()=>{index++;render()};byId('submit').onclick=()=>{const missing=QUESTIONS.length-Object.keys(answers).length;if(missing&&!confirm(`باقي ${arabic(missing)} سؤال بدون إجابة هل تريد التسليم الآن`))return;submitted=true;const correct=QUESTIONS.filter(q=>answers[q.id]===q.answer).length;const pct=Math.round(correct/QUESTIONS.length*100);const results=byId('results');results.hidden=false;results.innerHTML='';const title=document.createElement('h2');title.textContent='نتيجة الاختبار';const score=document.createElement('div');score.className='score';score.textContent=`${arabic(correct)} من ${arabic(QUESTIONS.length)} — ${arabic(pct)}٪`;const detail=document.createElement('p');detail.textContent=`الإجابات الصحيحة ${arabic(correct)} | غير الصحيحة أو المتروكة ${arabic(QUESTIONS.length-correct)}`;results.append(title,score,detail);QUESTIONS.forEach((q,i)=>{if(answers[q.id]===q.answer)return;const div=document.createElement('div');div.className='review';const h=document.createElement('strong');h.textContent=`السؤال ${arabic(i+1)} — ${q.q}`;const a=document.createElement('div');a.textContent=`الإجابة الصحيحة ${q.answer} — ${q.options.find(o=>o.letter===q.answer).text}`;div.append(h,a);results.append(div)});const retry=document.createElement('button');retry.className='secondary';retry.textContent='إعادة الاختبار';retry.onclick=()=>location.reload();results.append(retry);render();results.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})};render();</script></body></html>
